reason: An event-driven habit engine that detects correction signals, uses an on-demand model to propose habits, and stores only user-confirmed habits for later recall.

summaries.zh: 一个通过观察会话中的纠正信号、生成习惯候选并在用户确认后存储和回忆习惯的事件驱动引擎。
summaries.en: An event-driven habit engine that detects correction signals, proposes habits with an on-demand model, and stores and recalls them after user confirmation.

capabilities: observes session events for correction signals
calls a configured language model after reaching a signal threshold
stores confirmed habit candidates in persistent storage
requires two user confirmations before automatic promotion
